description: This is a React component for the 'InputValidationPage' in a frontend application. It handles displaying extracted JSON data, validation for required fields, and user interactions for filling missing data or re-uploading. The file includes utility functions for nested object value access and mutation, and manages UI state related to input validation, user menu, and display of extracted data.

methods.name: getValueAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from an object using a dot-separated string path.

methods.name: setValueAtPath
methods.description: Sets a nested value on an object using a dot-separated string path, mutating the object.

methods.name: isEmptyValue
methods.description: Determines if a value is considered empty for validation purposes.

methods.name: humanizePath
methods.description: Transforms a dot-separated path into a human-readable string with arrows.

methods.name: flattenObject
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested objects into an array of key/value pairs for display.

methods.name: getDisplayUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of the user from local storage or defaults to 'User'.

methods.name: InputValidationPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the validation UI, managing state, handling user interactions, and displaying extracted JSON data with validation errors.
